title: Have your say on local arts
titleZh: 为本地艺术发展提建议
summaryZh: 北爱尔兰就未来十年的艺术政策征求公众意见，提议关注社区艺术、人才培养及不同地区的机会。
levelReason: 编辑估计A2：短句说明公众咨询、艺术机会与日期，抽象政策词配中文释义。不是官方分级。

sentences.text: On 12 November 2026, Northern Ireland opened a public consultation about a new arts policy.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月12日，北爱尔兰就一项新的艺术政策启动公众咨询。

sentences.text: The Department for Communities wants to hear people’s views on plans for the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 社区事务部希望听取人们对未来十年计划的看法。

sentences.text: People can read the proposals and give their opinions before the consultation ends on 21 January 2027.
sentences.zh: 人们可以阅读提案，并在咨询于2027年1月21日结束前提出意见。

sentences.text: The proposed actions include better opportunities for people in different parts of Northern Ireland.
sentences.zh: 拟议行动包括为北爱尔兰不同地区的人们提供更好的机会。

sentences.text: They also include support for arts activities in local communities, as part of the planned changes.
sentences.zh: 这些行动还包括支持当地社区的艺术活动，作为拟议改变的一部分。

sentences.text: Another aim is to help people develop their artistic talent and find ways to show their work.
sentences.zh: 另一个目标是帮助人们发展艺术才能，并找到展示作品的方式。

sentences.text: The proposals also encourage different parts of the arts sector to work together.
sentences.zh: 提案还鼓励艺术领域的不同方面开展合作。

sentences.text: This consultation is part of a wider programme that began in 2024.
sentences.zh: 这次咨询属于一项始于2024年的更大计划。

sentences.text: That programme covers the arts, museums, public libraries and historic places.
sentences.zh: 该计划涵盖艺术、博物馆、公共图书馆和历史场所。

sentences.text: The department is asking about proposed aims and actions; the consultation does not mean that all the changes are already in place.
sentences.zh: 社区事务部正在就拟议目标和行动征求意见；开展咨询并不意味着所有改变均已落实。

sentences.note: does not mean that…用于区分征求意见与已经落实，避免把提议当成事实。

questions.text: Which arts activities would you like to see in your community?
questions.zh: 你希望在社区看到哪些艺术活动？

expressions.text: One change I would suggest is …
expressions.zh: 我会建议的一项改变是……
expressions.note: 原创讨论表达，would使建议语气较委婉。
